title: ForecastingSubmission - Data API
description: Represents a submitted forecast. This object is available in API version 62.0 and later.

CurrencyIsoCode.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort
CurrencyIsoCode.description: The currency code of the forecast submission. If omitted, the default is USD.

ForecastOwnerId.description: The ID of the forecast owner. This field is a relationship field.

ForecastingGroupItemId.description: Reserved for future use. Forecast submissions aren't supported in forecast types with groups.

ForecastingTypeId.description: The ID of the forecast type. This field is a relationship field.

IsLatest.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsLatest.description: Indicates if the forecast submission is the most recent submission. The default value is false.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: For internal use only. ID of this record.

Note.description: The note attached to the submitted forecast.

PeriodId.description: The ID of the period to which the submission applies. This field is a relationship field.

PeriodStartDate.description: Indicates the start date of the forecast period.

ProductFamily.description: Must be set to none. Forecast submissions aren't supported in forecast types grouped by product families.

SubmissionDateTime.description: The date and time that the forecast submission was made. Calculated internally.

Territory2Id.description: The ID of the territory to forecast on. This field is a relationship field.

special_access_rules: Available for forecast types that aren’t grouped by product family forecast.
usage: ForecastingSubmission is a detail object that contains the submitted item category values. Each record represents the values for a single item category. ForecastingSubmission is always used as a detail object for the submission, and inserted only as part of a transaction that includes all detail objects.
